name: tree-sitter-kama
description: tree-sitter grammar for the kama programming language
comment-devDependencies: PINNED EXACT, no caret. `tree-sitter generate` output is not byte-stable across CLI versions, and tools/check-treesitter.sh diffs the committed src/ against a fresh generate.
